latest_release.name: Craft Anything v0.5.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Give native OpenCode runs the Craft Anything tools and show their tool calls by @advokat11 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/800
* Stabilize loopback request and cancellation fixtures (R3.11) by @Afloat16 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/767
* Keep the model discovery test from depending on OpenCode being installed (R5.2) by @justinjohn0306 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/980
* Start the Advanced console's prompt box at three lines (#942, R2.9) by @justinjohn0306 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/979
* Stop counting a video or music player as a game (#953, R2.7) by @justinjohn0306 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/970
* Add Georgian (ka) UI catalog by @devius in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/775
* List MaterialCraft with the other Craft apps by @zitann2020 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/836
* List MaterialCraft in the Japanese Craft apps table by @zitann2020 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/837
* List MaterialCraft in the Korean Craft apps table by @zitann2020 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/838
* List MaterialCraft in the Chinese Craft apps table by @zitann2020 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/839
* Name the two modes plainly in Japanese: 外から観察 and 中まで解析 by @zitann2020 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/679
* Compare remote query test paths canonically on macOS (R5.2) by @doubektomas in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/949
* Find app.asar beside an .exe target in the study step by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/956
* Show Ghidra's wait and progress lines in the build's activity feed by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/955
* Truncate long app file names on the Make screen by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/869
* Keep zoom between 50% and 200% (R2.9) by @sanketdofe in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/908
* Keep the Advanced console's status clear of its tabs when narrow (R2.9) by @justinjohn0306 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/984
* Claim R5.6: a denied Accessibility permission is not a success by @mavericzz in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/887
* craft-anything-clonar-softwares by @Cleyson in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/985
* Stop sending empty assistant messages to OpenAI-compatible providers by @yashpatadiya1724-cmyk in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/854
* More format parsers keep to their declared lengths and refuse impossible values (R3.12) by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/986
* Record the Windows start-fallback live check: the start after a killed one draws with WARP and opens (R5.1) by @00xJS in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/911
* Check packaged Deep builds before publishing a release (R5.1) by @doubektomas in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/982
* Hide the home scrollbar when scrolling is not needed (R2.9) by @Pratikkk1829 in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/988
* List new projects in the sidebar immediately and attach existing folders by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/987
* Put the switches under the prompt box on two lines when they don't fit by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/989
* Add Spanish, Italian and Vietnamese to the app's languages by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/990
* A hand-off that ends just before a kill reports its exit, and its Windows test waits for the launcher (R5.2) by @00xJS in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/910
* Count cached tokens in usage.json (R5.4) by @SoldierPePe in https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/pull/958
* Mark open plan steps as stopped when

detail.readme_excerpt:
Craft Anything

English · 日本語 · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 한국어 · Español · Français · Tiếng Việt · Português

See how any website, app or game works, then have AI build your own version; an open-source, clean-room engine in pure Rust.
Point it at a target, say what you want, and it studies the original with real inspection tools,
has a coding agent build a new project, checks the result against the original and refines it.

Download Craft Anything · ArtCraft · All Crafting Apps



A website project: each check says how alike the build is, you approve anything outside the rules, and the plan shows what's left.

> [!NOTE] > **ArtCraft is a community of artists from all walks of life.** Painters, photographers, > filmmakers, illustrators, designers, animators, hobbyists, and people who picked up a pencil > last week. If you make things, you're one of us. **[Come say hi on Discord](https://discord.gg/ar
